review.gallery: Eight official renders from Ellington’s project page and brochure, plus one official October 2026 site photograph. The full-building render leads the gallery and card. The dated construction image records progress and does not establish handover.
review.location: The current developer brochure shows the project marker and 15 driving estimates. The named portfolio map supports the Kahraba North West Road location, as does the direct official ground-floor drawing. The Mitchell’s point is building-level and approximate.
review.floorPlans: Twenty complete drawings: 11 residences, 7 typical floor plates and 2 amenity plans. The direct floor plan file matches the Mitchell’s mirror by SHA-256. The direct amenities set supplies the ground and first-floor originals. The first-floor amenities drawing labels the pool deck. A rooftop pool mentioned in website prose has no supporting rooftop drawing.

unavailable: Surveyed visitor entrance, standalone retail, basement, podium or roof plans, contracted areas and photographed finished interiors.
